items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: Quint Davis, George Wein’s protégé, booked me and a great bass player named George French

ctx.x: Okay. Quint Davis, George Wein’s protégé, booked me and a great bass player named George French and a drummer who played with Alvin Batiste out of Baton Rouge named Herman Jackson as his rhythm section for an entire European tour. Unbeknownst to me Chuck wanted the great — was it James Johnson? The great Sun Records.
